composition: D(m) = (Rainbow_s1(m), ..., Rainbow_sk(m)); actual Rainbow at width w
attack: concat.joint_collision_prefixed: shared random 2-block prefix, then a joint H-collision over all stripes with bridge-offset agreement

rows.note: one run hit the 2^26 cap; median from 7, biased low

verification: every solved collision checked against the full 4-word digest of every stripe
not_a_lower_bound: the best attack built here, not a proof no better attack exists
no_secret: every seed is part of the hash; the keyholder pays the same joint cost as the attacker, so this composition cannot give bounded private latency
